artists.biography: Cedric Burnside (born August 26, 1978) is an American electric blues drummer, guitarist, singer and songwriter. He is the grandson of North Mississippi blues legend R.L. Burnside. He is the winner of the Blues Music Awards "Best New Artist Debut" for the record: 'The Two Man Wrecking Crew' in 2009 and "Drummer of the Year" in 2010. After many successful years of touring the world with Lightnin' Malcolm as 'the Juke Joint Duo', Burnside started the band Cedric Burnside Project. Read more on Last.fm. perplexity.description:
Released on September 14, 2018, Benton County Relic is Cedric Burnside’s debut album for Single Lock Records and a defining work in his discography. The album is rooted in Mississippi Hill Country blues, a tradition Burnside inherited as the grandson of legendary bluesman R.L. Burnside. Musically, Benton County Relic features Burnside’s signature blend of raw, rhythmic guitar, driving drum patterns, and soulful vocals, often augmented by Brian Jay’s contributions on drums, guitar, and vocals. The sound is both deeply traditional and refreshingly modern, eschewing standard blues formulas for a more hypnotic, groove-oriented approach.

Benton County Relic marked Burnside’s second Grammy nomination, earning a spot in the Best Traditional Blues Album category at the 61st GRAMMY Awards. The album was praised for its authenticity and energy, with critics highlighting its ability to honor blues traditions while pushing the genre forward. Produced by Burnside and Brian Jay, and recorded primarily in Brooklyn, the album stands as a significant achievement in contemporary blues, solidifying Cedric Burnside’s reputation as a leading voice in the genre.
